info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Facility By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables the modification of specific attributes for facilities related to equipment maintenance. By utilizing a unique identifier, users can make targeted updates, ensuring that information is accurate and up-to-date. The primary consumers of this API include facility managers and maintenance coordinators within banking operations, allowing them to streamline their processes. This endpoint supports enhancing operational efficiency by ensuring that facility data reflects the latest maintenance requirements.

patch.summary: Update the equipment maintenance details for a specific facility.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the information related to equipment maintenance for the specified facility. You can modify various attributes, ensuring that the maintenance records are current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the maintenance details for the specified equipment identified by RES-100045. Ensure to provide the necessary fields to correctly modify the maintenance records.
